## Review category (docs PRs only)

<!--
If this PR changes docs and you're on the Supabase team, check one category. It sets the review deadline, counted in business days from when the PR is marked ready for review.
PRs from forks are always reviewed as Low, so you can skip this section.
-->

- [ ] Critical: needs a review as soon as possible (1 business day)
- [ ] Urgent: the feature ships soon, or it's blocking something else (3 business days)
- [ ] Moderate: good to have soon, not urgent (5 business days)
- [ ] Low: get to it when you can (10 business days)

## Review instructions

Provide a clear numbered procedure that the PR reviewer can walk through.

1. For example, `Open the live and preview links side-by-side.`
2. For example, `See the issue is fixed.`
